## Specific task description

Task instruction: Open the cabinet with light wood panels's drawer and set the rectangular red playingcards holder inside with the other arm.

Task description: Open the drawer of the light-wood cabinet and place the red rectangular playing-card box inside. The box is in front of the cabinet on the right; the right arm will move it while the left arm opens the drawer.

Success criteria: The card box must be inside the open drawer, close to the target storage position in both horizontal directions. It must be slightly higher than its original tabletop position and within the drawer's storage-height range. The right gripper must be open and release the box.

## Execution tips

- With the left gripper, choose a section of the white horizontal handle away from its end mounts with enough clearance behind it. Adjust the opening to its thickness, surround it with both fingers, then pull gently outward along the drawer slide direction, reducing panel pressure and lateral twisting.
- The card box is at the lower right of the main view and partly outside the image. Use live observations to confirm both edges, and grasp flat opposing sides away from the corners. Open slightly wider than that section and confirm the fingers surround the box, avoiding merely pressing its top or pushing it away.
- Make necessary pose adjustments in the open space outside the cabinet, leaving clearance for both card box and right gripper through the drawer opening. The left arm can hold the drawer open while leaving space for the right, reducing collisions with the top edge, sidewalls, or other hand.
- Before releasing the right gripper, let the card box rest on the drawer support surface and leave room to withdraw the fingers, avoiding a suspended drop or pulling the box back out during withdrawal.
